items.title: 56422_Leonard Phillips oral history interview
items.q: I was in that group. We had a chick playing piano, her name was Clara Bowe. ... So she was with us.

ctx.x: Well, you see, it was a girl on the show named Clara... What the hell was Clara's name...? I can't think of her last name. Anyway, she was crazy about Les.
In what month of 1926 was this?
